builds.howItPlays: You put your units down in pairs, because Disciple of Shen (2 cost) gets +3 Might while defending a battlefield where you have exactly one other unit, and each turn Shen can give one of them Tank so attackers have to deal their damage to it first. You keep those battlefields with spells you play on your opponent's turn, then land Shen, Leader of the Kinkou Order (6 cost), who scores you an extra point each time he holds a battlefield next to one other unit.
builds.whyYou: You like choosing a spot on the board and making your opponent pay to take it. You don't mind waiting with cards in hand, because most of your spells are meant for your opponent's turn: cancelling a spell, stopping an attacker's damage, or protecting the unit they're about to hit. Each turn brings small decisions, like which two units to pair up, which one gets Shen's Tank, and when to spend a reaction or save it. Games run into the middle turns and hinge on how well you read the fight, not on lucky draws. If holding the line and winning slowly on points sounds fun, Shen suits you.
builds.ratingNotes: Changed 2026-09-25 (re-rate from the deck picks, style "Disciple of Shen Hold", decided by the lead agent for this run): relabelled Control to Midrange, and coordinates moved from 1/1/6/2.5 to 4.5/4.5/7/4 (pace/stance/complexity/variance), the mean of three scored decks from tools.ts style (labels Midrange, Midrange, Midrange). Pace moved 3.5, Stance 3.5, Variance 1.5. The old numbers and label came from two guide quotes (riftboundguide.com, skillshotzgaming.com), not scored lists. The current lists run 20 to 22 units and fight over two battlefields with pairs of defenders, so they sit in the middle rather than at the turtle end. deckListUrl moved from the bare /decks page to Qilby's Barcelona list. The Barcelona system import (e20eb22f) has 39 cards, so the display is Qilby's identical 40-card repost. I removed both old guideUrls because I did not re-read them in this pass to confirm they describe this list and not the starter. Scored decks: Best of Barcelona Shen (Qilby; 2026 RQ Best of) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/85f3930b-3d5f-44bb-94e5-f2ed10542ce4 Midrange 4.5/4.5/7/4. SHEN FOR THE HOLD (magikarpshiny; matchups, pre-ban) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/1b61ff4f-4b92-4774-a645-4f16ab796fb0 Midrange 4.5/4.5/7/4.5. Armed and Pitiful (Shen) (MEAN; guide, pre-ban) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/2db7bf92-c307-421b-8e20-f9e2ea1b64d4 Midrange 4.5/4.5/7.5/4. Adjustments on all three sheets: pace -0.5, because Grove of the God-Willow, Kinkou Temple and Forbidding Waste (Fortified Position on MEAN's) reward holding and defending, which makes games longer; complexity +0.5, because the Legend's Tank grant has to be timed every turn. Deciding cards: Pace comes from only 2 to 5 cheap units against 2 to 6 cards costing 5 or more (Vi, Peacekeeper, Irelia, Fervent, Shen, Leader of the Kinkou Order), with 22 to 25 reactive cards. Stance comes from 18 to 23 answers (Defy, Back Off, Ki Barrier, Charm, Hidden Blade, Emperor's Divide) against about 9 pressure cards and 5 to 10 own-plan cards, a slightly defensive balance (-0.25 to -0.38). Complexity comes from 13 to 16 intricate cards: Disciple of Shen's exactly-one-other-unit condition, Hidden cards, Meditation's optional exhaust, Sona's rune readying, and reaction timing. Variance comes from no luck or swing cards and 7 to 11 card-draw cards. The formula scores it higher (5 to 5.5 raw) because the lists spread across many 2-ofs, and the raters judged 3 to 3.5, so the final 4 to 4.5 sits between them. The scorer suggested Tempo on some sheets because of the reactive count. Raters kept Midrange because the plan is holding battlefields, not cheap threats. Legend ability: exhaust Shen to give a friendly unit Tank this turn (it must be assigned combat damage first). Also played: Zhonya's Hourglass Shen https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/e5bd9fbd-64c3-4aa4-a8d8-b8e29ed9a6aa (llcoolranch, 13 likes, edited 2026-09-22 after the ban, Midrange 5/4.5/7/4) and https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/c7cfa86d-e3eb-4694-b1fc-60ee923f678c (tinysnowmen, Midrange 4.5/4/7/4); Stun Poro Shen https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/d388e1ad-6a51-44f3-8c8a-3eb379e54cd8 (ratchetash, 35 likes, video, Midrange 5/5/7/4) and https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/0a204b6e-35fe-4a1a-8ffe-f0fc94d4d864 (Fate's Hand, Singapore prep, Midrange 5/4.5/7/3.5); B.F.
